title: After `migrate:fresh --seed` the catalogue serves stale product ids from a 5-minute cache; add-to-cart fails with "The selected product id is invalid"
steps: docker compose exec laravel-api php artisan migrate:fresh --seed  — without cache:clear
POST /carts/{id} with the product id from the list

body.message: The selected product id is invalid.

product_id: The selected product id is invalid.

expected: the catalogue returns the current product ids after a documented reseed, so add-to-cart works
workaround: docker compose exec laravel-api php artisan cache:clear (or wait 5 minutes, or use POST /refresh which flushes the cache)
note: migrate:fresh alone does not reproduce this if the cache is empty. The list must be cached before the reseed.
